name: Cheetah
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats only meat

features.claim: The cheetah has a slim, lightly built body with a small, streamlined head and a short snout.
features.quote: The cheetah is a slim-bodied, spotted cat characterised by a small, streamlined head, a short snout, black tear-like facial streaks, a deep chest, long limbs and a long tail.

features.claim: It has long thin legs and a long spotted tail.
features.quote: Its long thin legs and long spotted tail are necessary for fast running.

features.claim: Its fur is tawny to creamy white or pale buff, darker along the middle of the back.
features.quote: The cheetah's coat is typically tawny to creamy white or pale buff, but darker in the mid-back portion.

features.claim: Its body is covered with about 2,000 evenly spaced solid black spots.
features.quote: The rest of the body is covered with around 2,000 evenly spaced, oval or round solid black spots, each measuring roughly 3–5 cm (1.2–2.0 in).

features.claim: Its chin, throat, belly and the lower parts of its legs are white with no markings.
features.quote: The chin, throat and underparts of the legs and the belly are white and devoid of markings.

features.claim: Black tear-like streaks run from the corners of its eyes down the nose to the mouth.
features.quote: The pronounced tear streaks are unique to the cheetah and originate from the corners of the eyes and run down the nose to the mouth.

features.claim: Its ears are small, short and rounded, with black patches on the back.
features.quote: The ears are small, short and rounded; they are tawny at the base and on the edges and marked with black patches on the back.

features.claim: It has a short, rough mane along the neck and shoulders.
features.quote: There is a short, rough mane, covering at least 8 cm (3.1 in) along the neck and the shoulders; this feature is more prominent in males.

features.claim: Its claws are slightly curved, blunt and only partly retractable.
features.quote: The slightly curved claws are shorter and straighter than those of other cats, lack a protective sheath and are partly retractile.

features.claim: It stands 67–94 cm tall at the shoulder and its head-and-body length is 1.1 to 1.5 m.
features.quote: It has a height of 67–94 cm (2.20–3.08 ft) at the shoulder, and the head-and-body length is between 1.1 and 1.5 m (3 ft 7 in and 4 ft 11 in).

features.claim: Its eyes are set high and have round pupils.
features.quote: The eyes are set high and have round pupils.

not_this.claim: A cheetah does not have the leopard's rosettes, and it does have tear streaks.
not_this.quote: Although similar at first glance, the leopard has rosettes instead of spots and does not have tear streaks.

not_this.claim: Its claws are not fully retractable like other big cats' claws.
not_this.quote: This is a major point of difference between the cheetah and the other big cats, which have fully retractable claws.

second_reading.claim: Its tail ends in a bushy white tuft and its last third has four to six dark rings or stripes.
second_reading.quote: While the first two-thirds of the tail are covered in spots, the final third is marked with four to six dark rings or stripes.
second_reading.why: the sentence does not support it

second_reading.claim: The sources give different shoulder heights and weights for the cheetah.
second_reading.quote: The cheetah stands 70–90 centimetres (28–35 in) at the shoulder, and weighs 21–72 kilograms (46–159 lb).
second_reading.why: the sentence does not support it

second_reading.claim: The sources give different head-and-body lengths for the cheetah.
second_reading.quote: The head-and-body length ranges from 112–150 centimetres (44–59 in).
second_reading.why: the sentence does not support it

second_reading.claim: What the tear streaks are for is not well understood.
second_reading.quote: The role of these streaks is not well understood, they may protect the eyes from the sun's glare or could be used to define facial expressions.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it
